title: #334 Weather
prompt: Some people prefer to live in places that have the same weather or climate all year long. Others like to live in areas where the weather changes several times a year. What is your opinion?

promptSegments.text: Some people prefer to live in places that have the same weather or climate all year long.
Others like to live in areas where the weather changes several times a year.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu rõ mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Bảo vệ quan điểm bằng 2 lý do rõ ràng.
